get.summary: Newznab/Torznab search and NZB download API
get.description:
The entry point download clients such as Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr and Readarr call. It follows the Newznab specification (https://newznab.readthedocs.io/en/latest/misc/api/); /torznab/api is the Torznab variant and /rss the same call with an RSS style answer. Appending an indexer name (/api/{indexerName}) restricts the search to that one configured indexer.

The parameters are the Newznab ones, taken from the query string:
* apikey — the API key from the main configuration, required
* t — what to do: search, tvsearch, movie, book, audio, caps, get, details, getnfo, stats
* q — the search string
* cat — comma separated Newznab category IDs, e.g. 5030,5040
* o — the output format, xml (default) or json
* limit and offset — paging, limit defaults to 100
* minage, maxage — age of the results in days; minsize, maxsize — size in megabytes
* imdbid, tmdbid, tvdbid, rid, tvmazeid, season, ep, author, title — what to search for when not searching by query
* id — the GUID of a result for t=get, t=details and t=getnfo

The answer is the Newznab XML (or JSON) the specification describes, including its error format; this document does not repeat it.

ExternalApiError.description: The body of every error answer except the bodyless 404 of a missing or wrong API key

status.description: The HTTP status code, repeated here so a client that only reads the body has it

message.description: A human readable explanation. Not a stable contract; use the code.
message.example: limit must be between 1 and 500 but was 501

ExternalBackupEntry.description: One backup ZIP in the configured backup folder

filename.description: The file name, e.g. nzbhydra-2026-09-09-12-00-00.zip. Pass it to GET /externalapi/v1/backups/{filename} to download the file.

createdAt.description: When the file was created, as reported by the file system

ExternalAverageResponseTime.description: An indexer's average response time and how it compares to the others

delta.description: Difference in milliseconds to the average of all indexers

ExternalCountPerDayOfWeek.description: A count per day of the week

day.description: The short English day name: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat or Sun

count.description: How many events fell on that day

ExternalCountPerHourOfDay.description: A count per hour of the day

hour.description: The hour of the day, 0 to 23

count.description: How many events fell in that hour

ExternalDownloadPerAge.description: How many downloads were made of content of a given age

age.description: The age of the content in days

count.description: How many downloads had that age

ExternalDownloadsPerAgeStats.description: How old the downloaded content was

percentOlder1000.description: Percentage of downloads whose content was older than 1000 days

percentOlder2000.description: Percentage of downloads whose content was older than 2000 days

percentOlder3000.description: Percentage of downloads whose content was older than 3000 days

averageAge.description: Average age of the downloaded content in days

downloadsPerAge.description: The number of downloads per age in days

ExternalIndexerApiAccessStats.description: How often an indexer was called and how well those calls went

percentConnectionError.description: Percentage of calls that failed to connect

averageAccessesPerDay.description: Average number of calls per day in the time range

ExternalIndexerDownloadShare.description: An indexer's share of all downloads in the time range

total.description: Number of downloads from this indexer

share.description: Percentage of all downloads that came from this indexer

ExternalIndexerScore.description: How much unique content an indexer contributed compared to the others

averageUniquenessScore.description: Average uniqueness score over the involved searches

involvedSearches.description: Number of searches this indexer took part in

uniqueDownloads.description: Downloads of results only this indexer provided

providedDownloads.description: Downloads of results this indexer provided, exclusive or not

coveragePercent.description: Percentage of downloaded results this indexer also had

exclusivePercent.description: Percentage of downloaded results only this indexer had

sharedContribution.description: Contribution to results that several indexers provided

legacyObservations.description: Observations recorded before the corrected scoring was introduced

correctedObservations.description: Observations recorded with the corrected scoring

ExternalSharePerUserOrIp.description: A user's or IP's share of all searches or downloads

key.description: The user name or the IP address

count.description: Number of searches or downloads made by it

percentage.description: Percentage of all searches or downloads it accounts for

ExternalStatsResponse.description: Aggregated statistics for a time range. A section that was not requested is null.

after.description: Start of the time range the statistics were calculated for, inclusive

before.description: End of the time range the statistics were calculated for

numberOfEnabledIndexers.description: How many of the configured indexers are enabled

indexerApiAccessStats.description: Section INDEXER_API_ACCESS: how often each indexer was called and how well

indexerScores.description: Section INDEXER_SCORES: how much unique content each indexer contributed

avgResponseTimes.description: Section AVG_RESPONSE_TIMES: average response time per indexer

indexerDownloadShares.description: Section INDEXER_DOWNLOAD_SHARES: share of all downloads per indexer

downloadsPerDayOfWeek.description: Section DOWNLOADS_PER_DAY_OF_WEEK: downloads per day of the week

downloadsPerHourOfDay.description: Section DOWNLOADS_PER_HOUR_OF_DAY: downloads per hour of the day

searchesPerDayOfWeek.description: Section SEARCHES_PER_DAY_OF_WEEK: searches per day of the week

searchesPerHourOfDay.description: Section SEARCHES_PER_HOUR_OF_DAY: searches per hour of the day

successfulDownloadsPerIndexer.description: Section SUCCESSFUL_DOWNLOADS_PER_INDEXER: successful and failed downloads per indexer

downloadSharesPerUser.description: Section DOWNLOAD_SHARES_PER_USER: share of all downloads per user

downloadSharesPerIp.description: Section DOWNLOAD_SHARES_PER_IP: share of all downloads per IP

searchSharesPerUser.description: Section SEARCH_SHARES_PER_USER: share of all searches per user

searchSharesPerIp.description: Section SEARCH_SHARES_PER_IP: share of all searches per IP

userAgentSearchShares.description: Section USER_AGENT_SEARCH_SHARES: share of all searches per user agent

userAgentDownloadShares.description: Section USER_AGENT_DOWNLOAD_SHARES: share of all downloads per user agent

downloadsPerAgeStats.description: Section DOWNLOADS_PER_AGE: how old the downloaded content was

ExternalSuccessfulDownloadsPerIndexer.description: How many downloads from an indexer succeeded and how many failed

countAll.description: Number of downloads from this indexer

ExternalUserAgentShare.description: A user agent's share of all searches or downloads

userAgent.description: The user agent as sent by the client

count.description: Number of searches or downloads made with it

percentage.description: Percentage of all searches or downloads it accounts for

ExternalPingResponse.description: Proof that the API key was accepted and that the instance is up

ExternalIdentifier.description: One identifier a search was made with

key.description: The name of a media ID type: IMDB, TMDB, TVDB, TVRAGE, TVMAZE, TVIMDB, TRAKT or TVTITLE

ExternalPageExternalSearchHistoryEntry.description: One page of a paged answer

page.description: The page that was returned, 1 based

limit.description: How many entries a page holds at most

totalElements.description: How many entries match the filter in total, over all pages

totalPages.description: How many pages the filter yields at the current limit

ExternalSearchHistoryEntry.description: One search from the search history

id.description: The internal ID of the search

source.description: Where the search came from: INTERNAL (the web interface) or API

searchType.description: The kind of search: SEARCH, TVSEARCH, MOVIE, BOOK or MUSIC

category.description: The name of the category that was searched in

title.description: The title that was searched for, if the search was made by title

author.description: The author that was searched for, for book searches

season.description: The season that was searched for, for TV searches

episode.description: The episode that was searched for, for TV searches

minAge.description: Minimum age of the results in days, if one was requested

maxAge.description: Maximum age of the results in days, if one was requested

minSize.description: Minimum size of the results in megabytes, if one was requested

maxSize.description: Maximum size of the results in megabytes, if one was requested

identifiers.description: The identifiers the search was made with, e.g. an IMDB ID

selectedIndexers.description: The names of the indexers that were searched, sorted alphabetically

username.description: The user who made the search, if users are configured

ip.description: The IP the search came from

userAgent.description: The user agent the search was made with

ExternalNotificationHistoryEntry.description: One notification from the notification history

id.description: The internal ID of the notification

eventType.description: What happened, e.g. RESULT_DOWNLOAD or INDEXER_DISABLED

messageType.description: How the notification was shown: INFO, SUCCESS, WARNING or FAILURE

body.example: Example.Show.S01E01.1080p.WEB-DL-EXMPL was downloaded from Example Indexer

urls.description: The Apprise URLs the notification was sent to, split on commas and line breaks

displayed.description: Whether the notification was displayed in the web interface

ExternalPageExternalNotificationHistoryE.description: One page of a paged answer

page.description: The page that was returned, 1 based

limit.description: How many entries a page holds at most

totalElements.description: How many entries match the filter in total, over all pages

totalPages.description: How many pages the filter yields at the current limit

ExternalDownloadHistoryEntry.description: One download from the download history

id.description: The internal ID of the download

title.description: The title of the downloaded result

indexer.description: The name of the indexer the result came from

category.description: Always null: the download history does not store the category of the search the result came from. Reserved so that it can be filled without a new API version.

sizeBytes.description: Always null: the download history does not store the size of the result. Reserved so that it can be filled without a new API version.

ageDays.description: The age of the result in days at the time it was downloaded

accessType.description: How the file was accessed: REDIRECT (to the indexer) or PROXY (through NZBHydra)

accessSource.description: Where the download came from: INTERNAL (the web interface) or API

status.description: The state the download ended in, e.g. NZB_ADDED or CONTENT_DOWNLOAD_SUCCESSFUL

error.description: The error message if the download failed
error.example: The indexer did not answer within 10 seconds

externalId.description: The ID the download client gave the download, if it reported one

username.description: The user who made the download, if users are configured

ip.description: The IP the download came from

userAgent.description: The user agent the download was made with

ExternalPageExternalDownloadHistoryEntry.description: One page of a paged answer

page.description: The page that was returned, 1 based

limit.description: How many entries a page holds at most

totalElements.description: How many entries match the filter in total, over all pages

totalPages.description: How many pages the filter yields at the current limit

backups.description: The backup files in the configured backup folder, newest first

apikey.description: The API key from the main configuration. Required unless the instance runs without one.

t.description: What to do: search, tvsearch, movie, book, audio, caps, get, details, getnfo or stats.

cat.description: Newznab category IDs to search in, comma separated.

rid.description: TVRage ID of the series to search for.

tvdbid.description: TVDB ID of the series to search for.

tvmazeid.description: TVMaze ID of the series to search for.

imdbid.description: IMDb ID of the movie to search for, without the leading tt.

tmdbid.description: TMDb ID of the movie to search for.

season.description: The season to search for, for tvsearch.

ep.description: The episode to search for, for tvsearch.

author.description: The author to search for, for book searches.

title.description: The title to search for instead of a query.

offset.description: How many results to skip, for paging.

limit.description: How many results to return at most.

minage.description: Minimum age of the results in days.

maxage.description: Maximum age of the results in days.

minsize.description: Minimum size of the results in megabytes.

maxsize.description: Maximum size of the results in megabytes.

id.description: The GUID of a result, for t=get, t=details and t=getnfo.

raw.description: Whether the results are returned unprocessed.

o.description: The output format: xml (default) or json.

cachetime.description: How long a repeated search may be answered from the cache, in minutes.

extended.description: Whether the extended result attributes are returned.

apiKey.description: The API key from the main configuration (main.apiKey). It may also be passed as the apikey query parameter.
apiKey.name: X-Api-Key
